purpose: Phase harness for the Meditherapy influencer seeding Codex plugin

phases.goal: Lock the public, verifiable problem definition.
gate: Problem maps to ontology, causal hypothesis, and iteration loop

phases.goal: Convert Meditherapy products into product-fit parameters.
gate: Every MVP product has concern, content, risk, and KPI tags
Gender is not the first-order recommendation criterion

phases.goal: Collect 30 public influencer candidates and 300 content observations.
gate: At least 24 candidates satisfy required fields
Each segment reaches at least 80 percent of its target
Each candidate has 10 sampled contents or a documented shortage reason
Comment raw text is not stored

phases.goal: Normalize public observations into scoreable influencer profiles.
gate: Every recommendation field is traceable to collected data

phases.goal: Score products and creators and produce causal seeding hypotheses.
gate: Rationale separates self, audience, content, market, and risk

phases.goal: Convert recommendations into executable seeding briefs.
gate: Required disclosures and avoid-claims are present

phases.goal: Collect result data and separate public proxy KPIs from internal conversion KPIs.
inputs: internal click or sales data if available
gate: Public and internal data sources are separated
Sales success is not claimed without sales data
Predefined KPIs are not changed after results

phases.goal: Rank the existing influencer DB for one new product without running new public research.
gate: Unmapped product tags remain needs_product_mapping or unknown
Hard exclusions are applied before ranking
needs_more_data candidates do not appear as high-confidence top recommendations
Score trace and natural-language rationale do not conflict

phases.goal: Decide whether the existing DB is sufficient or whether limited additional research is needed.
gate: Research need is explained with quantitative triggers
Suggested search queries map to new product tags
Research scope is limited to missing product segments

phases.goal: Run limited public research only when Phase 6B requires it, then merge new candidates and rerank.
gate: New candidate source URLs are traceable
Raw comment text and sensitive personal data are not stored

phases.goal: Independently review planning, code behavior, recommendation logic, and risk handling.
gate: No high-confidence recommendation from insufficient data

phases.goal: Convert campaign outcomes into the next experiment rules.
Package the submission with plugin files, README, data, and logs.
gate: README, data, and logs do not conflict
